title: A Rank With No Room
setup: Your queen has already burrowed to b2, and White's back rank is jammed with its own pieces.
hint: The white king has two holes beside it and no third, so look for a check its crowded first rank cannot answer.
explanation:
## The Idea

Every square around e1 is either taken by White's own pieces or swept by the queen as it lands, so a safe check on the first rank ends the game. {{Qc1#}} cannot be captured: the knight on b1 shuts the rook out, and the pawn on c2 blocks the white queen.
